subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — KiteBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@kitebank.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — KiteBank

Hi Samir / Asha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions from the payments and fraud teams. Per our demo, I wanted to capture a short recap and a proposed POC plan so your evaluation cycle is clear and we can get systems & network approvals in parallel.

Quick demo recap:
- We showed real-time transaction enrichment, risk scoring, and a fast search/assistant prototype for your reconciliation workflows.
- Performance during the demo was consistent with our 95th p50/lower-latency profile at ~120ms p95 on a 4k token workload (internal test rig).

Proposed POC goals / success criteria (suggested):
1) Accuracy: Match current reconciliation automation baseline on the 50-case test set (F1 within 5% of baseline).
2) Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 300ms for 2k token requests during steady load.
3) Cost: Demonstrate avg cost-per-call improvement or comparable cost with 10% better throughput; we'll provide cost modeling.
4) Security/compliance: Successful network connectivity test + SOC2 evidence + audit log export validated by your infra team.

High-level POC plan (4 weeks suggested):
- Week 0 (this week): network/security approvals + sign SOW/PO if needed.
- Week 1: env setup — VPC peering / private endpoint, test keys, sample data ingestion (anonymized). Owner: Dylan.
- Week 2: integration & baseline runs — run the reconciliation test set, collect metrics. Owner: KiteBank data team + Dylan.
- Week 3: optimization & handoff — apply batching/quantization recommendations, collect final metrics; ML/engineering knowledge transfer. Owner: Camila + Dylan.
- Week 4: executive review & decision — results presentation, next-step commercial discussion.

Next steps I propose:
- Can your infra team confirm they can kick off network review (VPC peering + firewall rules)?
- If yes, can we target Tue Aug 24 for a technical kickoff?

I attached a short POC plan and our networking checklist for your security team to review.

Thanks — happy to adjust the timeline to match your internal windows.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-kitebank.pdf (7 pages), networking-sla-checklist.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@kitebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@kitebank.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — KiteBank

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the clear plan. Asha and I reviewed the POC doc this morning. A few quick notes from the infra/security side before we commit to the Tues kickoff:

- Networking: our security team needs a short window to review the networking checklist; can you confirm the IP ranges and whether the endpoint supports mTLS?
- Data: we'll need to confirm anonymization process for the 50-case test set; our legal needs the data-handling note.
- SLA: during the POC we need at least 99.5% availability of the test endpoint.

If you can confirm the IPs and mTLS support today, we'll aim to finish the review and confirm Tue Aug 24. Also, on success criteria — can we add an acceptance definition for false positives in fraud scoring (<= 2% false positive rate on the test set)?

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Payments Risk | KiteBank
samir.patel@kitebank.com

Hi Samir / Asha — quick technical answers below:

- IPs / mTLS: We support mTLS and can provide a short list of egress IP ranges or hostnames (we prefer hostname allowlisting for our managed private endpoints). I'll attach the detailed network diagram to the Drive link.
- Availability: For the POC environment we can commit to 99.5% availability. We'll instrument health checks and provide a small SLA guardrail for the trial period.
- False positive metric: Agreed — we'll include FP rate <= 2% as an acceptance criteria and add it to the evaluation dashboard.

I'll be the technical owner for setup and will coordinate with your infra contact. For the anonymization pipeline, we can run the sandbox ingestion into an isolated bucket and apply your transformation rules; we will not retain any raw PII after ingestion.

Planned technical kickoff: Tue Aug 24 at 10:00 AM ET — pending your infra sign-off. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short checklist for what we'll need from your side (keys, sample file layout, firewall approval).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
